common.tagline: All your installments and savings in one place.
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.offline: You're offline. You're seeing the last loaded data.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: See your card installments and savings on one screen. We never ask for your bank password.
login.linkSent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Tap the link in the email.
login.linkSentHint: If it doesn't arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder.
login.linkExpired: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
login.deleted: Your account and all your data were deleted.

promises.title: Our promises
promises.noBank: We never connect to your bank, hold money or move it.
promises.noCardNumber: We store only the last 4 digits of your card.
promises.delete: Download or fully delete your data whenever you want.

consent.title: About your data
consent.intro: Before you start, please read how we process your data and give the consents below.
consent.kvkkLabel: I have read and understood the privacy notice.
consent.abroadLabel: I give my explicit consent to my data being transferred to servers abroad (Supabase, Vercel, OpenAI, Resend, PostHog) so the service can work.
consent.abroadHelp: The app's servers are in the European Union. We can't provide the service without this consent.
consent.analyticsLabel: Anonymous usage statistics may be collected to improve the app.
consent.analyticsHelp: Amounts, merchant names and bank details are never sent.
consent.marketingLabel: I'd like to get emails about new features and offers.
consent.mustAccept: Please give the two required consents to continue.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.point1: How much do you owe on each card this month?
welcome.point2: How will your installment load change over the next 12 months?
welcome.point3: Are your savings beating inflation or falling behind?

install.title: Use it like an app
install.body: Add it to your home screen, open it with one tap and get reminders.
install.iosSteps: In Safari, tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen".

home.emptyTitle: Start by adding your first card
home.emptyBody: As you add cards and installment purchases, you'll see what you owe this month and over the next 12 months here.
home.comingSoon: Adding cards arrives in the next version.

account.title: Account
account.consentsHelp: You can change these permissions at any time.
account.abroadNote: To withdraw consent to the transfer abroad you need to delete your account, because the service can't run without these servers.
account.exportHelp: All your data downloads as a single JSON file.
account.deleteHelp: Your account, cards, installments, savings and every record are permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteButton: Delete my account and all my data

notice.title: Privacy notice
notice.draft: Draft: must be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

offlinePage.title: You're offline
offlinePage.body: We can't show this page because you haven't opened it before. Try again when you're back online.
